reason: recipeCheck bounds each recipe parent by the accumulator size i+1 and each generator by gs.size, so defaults cannot introduce an unproved group action.
group_preserves starts with the identity and applies the explicit composition premise in the same old[generator[j]] order as the decoder.
actionCheck bounds every final reference; actions_preserves transfers the property and actions_size proves the requested count.
array_all obtains every array member via a valid Fin index. packedCheck includes Check for every generator plus both recipe and final-reference bounds, so checked_actions supplies every Good premise.

word_run requires a positive action count and exact array size. Action index0 uses literal identity, which preserves any run independently of the array; all other arbitrary indices are reduced modulo n and use Good.
orient_run retains identity for payload0 and uses the proved word action otherwise. All nontrivial word maps use high-bit-preserving fastHalfPerm, not the bounded data decoder permute.
scope: Generic packed-group replay and run transport; concrete packedCheck certificates remain separate.
